Name: Wurmple
Flavor-Text: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

Name: Silcoon
Effects: Put 3 random cards from among Silcoon and Cascoon from your deck onto your Bench.
Flavor-Text: It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

Name: Beautifly
Effects: This attack does 30 more damage for each Evolution Pokémon on your Bench.
Flavor-Text: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey’s fluids.

Name: Cascoon
Effects: Put 3 random cards from among Silcoon and Cascoon from your deck onto your Bench.
Flavor-Text: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

Name: Dustox
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. 1 Special Condition from among Burned, Confused, and Poisoned is chosen at random, and your opponent's Active Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition. Any Special Conditions already affecting that Pokémon will not be chosen.
Flavor-Text: It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.

Name: Lileep
Effects: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: Lileep clings to rocks on the seabed. When prey comes close, this Pokémon entangles it with petallike tentacles.

Name: Cradily
Effects: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon. During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
Flavor-Text: Once Cradily catches prey in its tentacles, it digests them whole and absorbs their nutrients.

Name: Kricketot
Flavor-Text: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

Name: Kricketune
Flavor-Text: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

Name: Combee
Effects: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
Flavor-Text: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers nectar from flowers to please Vespiquen.

Name: Vespiquen ex
Effects: You may discard 1 of your Benched Basic [G] Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 70 more damage.
Ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 2 points.

Name: Karrablast
Flavor-Text: It spits a liquid from its mouth to melt through Shelmet’s shell. Karrablast doesn’t eat the shell— it eats only the contents.

Name: Shelmet
Flavor-Text: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.

Name: Accelgor
Effects: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Paralyzed. Shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.
Flavor-Text: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

Name: Dhelmise
Flavor-Text: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.

Name: Pheromosa
Effects: If you haven't gotten any points, this attack does 60 more damage.
Flavor-Text: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

Name: Poltchageist
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, when you put this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench, you may heal 20 damage from your Active [G] Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

Name: Sinistcha
Effects: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
Flavor-Text: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home’s floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

Name: Teal Mask Ogerpon
Effects: This attack does damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon equal to this Pokémon's remaining HP.
Flavor-Text: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

Name: Ponyta
Effects: Take a [R] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: If you’ve been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

Name: Rapidash
Flavor-Text: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd’s pace and direction of travel.

Name: Flareon
Effects: Discard Fire[R] Energy from this Pokémon. Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
Flavor-Text: It fluffs out its fur collar to cool down its body temperature, which can reach 1,650 degrees Fahrenheit.

Name: Moltres
Effects: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
Flavor-Text: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

Name: Cyndaquil
Effects: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
Flavor-Text: The fire that spouts from its back burns hottest when it is angry. The flaring flames intimidate foes.

Name: Quilava
Effects: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
Flavor-Text: The fur covering this Pokémon’s body never burns, no matter what. It can shrug off any kind of fire attack.

Name: Typhlosion ex
Effects: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
Ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 2 points.

Name: Houndour
Effects: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
Flavor-Text: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

Name: Houndoom
Effects: Flip a coin. If heads, discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

Name: Heatmor
Flavor-Text: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

Name: Psyduck
Effects: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, this Pokémon is now Confused.
Flavor-Text: If its chronic headache peaks, it may exhibit odd powers. It seems unable to recall such an episode.

Name: Golduck
Flavor-Text: It swims gracefully along on the quiet, slow- moving rivers and lakes of which it is so fond.

Name: Staryu
Effects: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn’t bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

Name: Starmie
Effects: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

Name: Carvanha
Flavor-Text: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

Name: Mega Sharpedo ex
Effects: Take a [W] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Benched [W] Pokémon.
Ex-Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 3 points.

Name: Wailmer
Flavor-Text: When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.

Name: Wailord ex
Effects: This Pokémon recovers from all Special Conditions.
Ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 2 points.

Name: Spheal
Flavor-Text: As it drifts among the waves, Spheal probes the sea. As soon as it spots prey, it informs the Walrein in its herd.

Name: Sealeo
Effects: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a [F] Pokémon, this attack does 70 more damage.
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon has a habit of spinning round things on its nose, whether those things are Poké Balls or Spheal.

Name: Walrein
Effects: Your opponent can't use any Supporter cards from their hand during their next turn.
Flavor-Text: Walrein’s tusks keep growing throughout its life. Tusks broken in battle will grow back to their usual impressive size in a year.

Name: Kyogre
Effects: Discard 3 [W] Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 50 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

Name: Oshawott
Flavor-Text: It’s said that Oshawott learned to maintain its scalchop with riverbed stones by mimicking humans it saw using whetstones.

Name: Dewott
Effects: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.
Flavor-Text: Dewott has a studious and stern personality. It masters the use of its scalchops through dedicated, repeated training.

Name: Samurott
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks from your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon until the end of your opponent's next turn.
Effects: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: Samurott leads its group strictly. Those who do not follow its rules receive a merciless thrashing.

Name: Alomomola
Effects: Heal 10 damage from each of your Benched Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: They float upon the open sea. Many water Pokémon gather in the area around Alomomola.

Name: Dewpider
Flavor-Text: It supports the water bubble that envelops its head with three of its legs. Sometimes it secretly swaps which legs are holding up the bubble.

Name: Araquanid
Effects: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.
Flavor-Text: It launches sticky water bubbles. Foes who lose consciousness while trapped inside these bubbles will get torn apart by Araquanid’s gnashing jaws.

Name: Bruxish
Flavor-Text: When sunlight reflects on the ripples created by a Bruxish grinding its teeth, the water all around sparkles brilliantly.

Name: Pikachu
Effects: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do −20 damage.
Flavor-Text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

Name: Raichu
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
Flavor-Text: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

Name: Shinx
Flavor-Text: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it’s in trouble.

Name: Luxio
Flavor-Text: By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.

Name: Luxray
Effects: This attack does 50 more damage for each point your opponent has gotten.
Flavor-Text: Luxray’s ability to see through objects comes in handy when it’s scouting for danger.

Name: Pachirisu
Effects: Discard the top card of your deck, and if that card is an Item, this attack does 20 more damage.
Flavor-Text: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

Name: Rotom ex
Effects: This attack does 10 more damage for each Item card in your discard pile.
Ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 2 points.

Name: Tynamo
Flavor-Text: These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.

Name: Eelektrik
Flavor-Text: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

Name: Eelektross
Effects: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to all of your opponent's Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It latches on to prey with its sucker mouth, sinking in its fangs and shocking the prey with powerful electricity.

Name: Thundurus
Effects: Discard a [L] Energy from this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.

Name: Helioptile
Effects: This attack does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: The sun powers this Pokémon’s electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.

Name: Heliolisk
Effects: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.

Name: Wattrel
Flavor-Text: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

Name: Kilowattrel
Flavor-Text: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

Name: Clefairy
Effects: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.
Flavor-Text: On nights with a full moon, they gather together and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field.

Name: Clefable
Flavor-Text: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.

Name: Drowzee
Flavor-Text: When it twitches its nose, it can tell where someone is sleeping and what that person is dreaming about.

Name: Hypno
Effects: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: Always holding a pendulum that it swings at a steady rhythm, it causes drowsiness in anyone nearby.

Name: Mime Jr.
Effects: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Draw a card for each card in your opponent's hand.
Flavor-Text: It looks for a Mr. Rime that’s a good dancer and carefully copies the Mr. Rime’s steps like an apprentice.

Name: Mr. Mime
Effects: If this Pokémon and your opponent's Active Pokémon have the same amount of Energy attached, this attack does 40 more damage.
Flavor-Text: It’s known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

Name: Mewtwo
Effects: This attack does 40 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: The research efforts of a certain scientist ultimately resulted in this Pokémon. Its powers are dedicated to battling.

Name: Ralts
Effects: Put a random Supporter card from your deck into your hand.
Flavor-Text: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

Name: Kirlia
Effects: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
Flavor-Text: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

Name: Chimecho
Effects: If you have the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does 40 more damage.
Flavor-Text: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.

Name: Wynaut
Effects: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon cost 1 [C] more.
Flavor-Text: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

Name: Woobat
Effects: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
Flavor-Text: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

Name: Swoobat
Effects: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused.
Flavor-Text: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon’s nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

Name: Hoopa
Effects: Before doing damage, shuffle all Pokémon Tools from each of your opponent's Pokémon into their deck.
Flavor-Text: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

Name: Oricorio
Effects: Discard a card from your hand. If you can't, this attack does nothing.
Flavor-Text: The elegant, attractive dance of these Oricorio is popular with adults, but the Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea.

Name: Makuhita
Flavor-Text: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

Name: Hariyama
Effects: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes +50 damage from attacks.
Flavor-Text: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

Name: Anorith
Flavor-Text: Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wings through the water like oars on a boat. This Pokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.

Name: Armaldo
Effects: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon. Choose a spot from among your opponent's Active Spot and Bench. At the end of your opponent's next turn, Knock Out the Pokémon in the spot you chose.
Flavor-Text: Though it lives on land, it’s also a good swimmer. It dives into the ocean in search of prey, using its sharp claws to take down its quarry.

Name: Groudon
Effects: This attack also does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.

Name: Mega Gallade ex
Effects: If you played a Supporter card from your hand during this turn, this attack does 50 more damage.
Ex-Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 3 points.

Name: Drilbur
Flavor-Text: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

Name: Excadrill
Flavor-Text: Its drill, which has evolved into steel, is strong enough to bore through iron plates. This Pokémon is a great help in tunnel construction.

Name: Timburr
Flavor-Text: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle heavy lumber without difficulty.

Name: Gurdurr
Effects: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

Name: Conkeldurr
Effects: Discard a Stadium in play.
Flavor-Text: Rather than rely on their strength, they master moves that make good use of centrifugal force to swing around concrete.

Name: Minior
Effects: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has an Ability, this attack does 40 more damage.
Flavor-Text: It feeds on dust in the atmosphere. The color of its core is said to be determined by the composition of the dust it eats.

Name: Grimer
Flavor-Text: When two of these Pokémon’s bodies are combined together, new poisons are created.

Name: Muk
Effects: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.
Flavor-Text: It’s so stinky! Muk’s body contains toxic elements, and any plant will wilt when it passes by.

Name: Poochyena
Effects: Draw a card for each Poochyena you have in play.
Flavor-Text: Poochyena pursue their prey in packs. Once the prey is exhausted, the pack finishes it off. But sometimes the prey retaliates, and the pack flees.

Name: Mightyena
Flavor-Text: Once it’s caught the scent of faraway prey, the leader gives a signal, and the whole pack moves out.

Name: Galarian Zigzagoon
Flavor-Text: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.

Name: Galarian Linoone
Effects: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.

Name: Galarian Obstagoon
Effects: This attack does 80 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

Name: Gulpin
Flavor-Text: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach comprises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.

Name: Swalot
Effects: If your opponent's Active Pokémon has less remaining HP than this Pokémon, this attack does 80 more damage.
Flavor-Text: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.

Name: Absol
Effects: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 30 more damage.
Flavor-Text: Because of this Pokémon’s ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

Name: Vullaby
Effects: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.

Name: Mandibuzz
Effects: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.
Flavor-Text: Watching from the sky, they attack weakened prey on the ground. They have a habit of decorating themselves with bones.

Name: Hoopa ex
Effects: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
This Pokémon also does 20 damage to itself.
Ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 2 points.

Name: Skarmory
Flavor-Text: Since the feathers that it sheds are thin and sharp, people apparently once used them as swords.

Name: Mawile
Effects: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
Flavor-Text: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

Name: Beldum
Ability-Effect: If you have another Beldum in play, this Pokémon's Retreat Cost is 2 less.
Flavor-Text: All its cells are magnets. It communicates with others of its kind by transmitting magnetic forces from its body.

Name: Metang
Effects: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 more damage for each heads.
Flavor-Text: It adores magnetic minerals, so it pursues Nosepass at speeds exceeding 60 mph.

Name: Metagross
Effects: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.
Flavor-Text: It firmly pins its prey using its four claws and large body. Then Metagross uses the mouth on its stomach to chew its prey to bits.

Name: Mega Metagross ex
Effects: This attack does 10 more damage for each [M] Energy attached to this Pokémon.
Ex-Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 3 points.

Name: Escavalier
Flavor-Text: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.

Name: Genesect
Effects: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

Name: Duraludon
Flavor-Text: Its metal body is durable but prone to retaining heat. It vents this heat from the slits in its tail.

Name: Archaludon
Effects: If this Pokémon has damage on it, this attack does 80 more damage.
Flavor-Text: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

Name: Varoom
Flavor-Text: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

Name: Revavroom
Ability-Effect: This Pokémon may have up to 2 Pokémon Tool cards attached to it.
Effects: During your next turn, this Pokémon's Overacceleration attack does +70 damage.
Flavor-Text: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

Name: Dratini
Effects: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
Flavor-Text: It is born large to start with. It repeatedly sheds its skin as it steadily grows longer.

Name: Dragonair
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may attach an Energy from your discard pile to your Active [N] Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It is called the divine Pokémon. When its entire body brightens slightly, the weather changes.

Name: Dragonite
Effects: Discard a random Energy from your opponent's Active Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It can fly in spite of its big and bulky physique. It circles the globe in just 16 hours.

Name: Rayquaza
Effects: Discard 2 random Energy from this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

Name: Mega Rayquaza ex
Effects: Discard all [R] and [L] Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 50 damage for each Energy you discarded in this way.
Ex-Rule: When your Mega Evolution Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 3 points.

Name: Noibat
Flavor-Text: Noibat can change the frequency of its sound waves at will, and it generates ultrasonic waves of up to 200,000 hertz.

Name: Noivern
Effects: 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen at random 3 times. For each time a Pokémon was chosen, do 60 damage to it.
Flavor-Text: In the dark, even Hydreigon are terrified of this Pokémon. But in the light, Noivern is the one that avoids battle.

Name: Turtonator
Effects: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
Flavor-Text: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.

Name: Drampa
Effects: Discard a random Energy from this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it’s angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

Name: Applin
Flavor-Text: Applin lives inside an apple. When an Applin is separated from its apple, its body loses moisture and the Pokémon grows weak.

Name: Dipplin
Effects: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 60 damage for each heads.
Flavor-Text: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

Name: Hydrapple
Effects: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 100 more damage.
Flavor-Text: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

Name: Cyclizar
Effects: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

Name: Rattata
Effects: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon is common but hazardous. Its sharp incisors can easily cut right through hard wood.

Name: Raticate
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may look at the top 4 cards of your deck and put all Item cards you find there into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
Flavor-Text: Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.

Name: Eevee
Effects: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
Flavor-Text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.

Name: Aipom
Flavor-Text: Its tail moves with greater dexterity than its hands. Making deft use of this tail, Aipom lives high among the treetops.

Name: Ambipom
Flavor-Text: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things that Ambipom rarely uses its hands.

Name: Skitty
Effects: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon do −20 damage.
Flavor-Text: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

Name: Delcatty
Effects: You may move any amount of Energy from your Pokémon in play to your other Pokémon in any way you like.
Flavor-Text: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

Name: Kecleon
Effects: If this Pokémon and your opponent's Active Pokémon have 1 or more of the same type of Energy attached, this attack does 30 more damage.
Flavor-Text: It changes color to blend in with its surroundings in order to sneak up on prey. It can’t make its belly pattern disappear, however.

Name: Pidove
Flavor-Text: It’s forgetful and not very bright, but many Trainers love it anyway for its friendliness and sincerity.

Name: Tranquill
Flavor-Text: These bright Pokémon have acute memories. Apparently delivery workers often choose them as their partners.

Name: Unfezant
Effects: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon is intelligent and intensely proud. People will sit up and take notice if you become the Trainer of one.

Name: Ducklett
Flavor-Text: It strengthens its body by diving into the depths of ponds, swimming around while looking for bog moss to eat.

Name: Swanna ex
Effects: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
Ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 2 points.

Name: Furfrou
Ability-Effect: This Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks.
Effects: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 50 more damage.
Flavor-Text: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.

Name: Type: Null
Flavor-Text: It was modeled after a mighty Pokémon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.

Name: Silvally
Effects: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Pokémon ex, this attack does 90 more damage.
Flavor-Text: The final factor needed to release this Pokémon’s true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.

Name: Order Pad
Description: Flip a coin. If heads, put a random Item card from your deck into your hand.

Name: Claw Fossil
Description: Play this card as if it were a 40-HP Basic [C] Pokémon. At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play. This card can't retreat.

Name: Root Fossil
Description: Play this card as if it were a 40-HP Basic [C] Pokémon. At any time during your turn, you may discard this card from play. This card can't retreat.

Name: Deceptive Needle
Description: At the end of your turn, if the [D] Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot, do 10 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

Name: Clear Veil
Description: Prevent all effects of attacks used by your opponent's Pokémon done to the Pokémon this card is attached to. (Existing effects are not removed.)

Name: Psychic
Description: You can use this card only if your Pokémon in the Active Spot has the Psychic attack. Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and move a random Energy from it to your opponent's Active Pokémon.

Name: Drayden
Description: During this turn, 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen 1 more time for the Draco Meteor attack used by your Pokémon.

Name: Skyla
Description: Switch your Active Stage 1 Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

Name: Wally
Description: Take a [C] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to 1 of your Stage 2 Pokémon.

Name: Soothing Shore
Description: At the end of each player's turn, that player heals 20 damage from each of their Pokémon that has any [W] Energy attached.

Name: Rainbow Cave
Description: Once during each player's turn, that player may discard the Energy that has been generated in their Energy Zone. If they do, the next Energy is produced.

Name: Wurmple
Flavor-Text: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

Name: Lileep
Effects: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: Lileep clings to rocks on the seabed. When prey comes close, this Pokémon entangles it with petallike tentacles.

Name: Kricketune
Flavor-Text: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

Name: Accelgor
Effects: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Paralyzed. Shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.
Flavor-Text: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.

Name: Ponyta
Effects: Take a [R] Energy from your Energy Zone and attach it to this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: If you’ve been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

Name: Quilava
Effects: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Burned.
Flavor-Text: The fur covering this Pokémon’s body never burns, no matter what. It can shrug off any kind of fire attack.

Name: Kyogre
Effects: Discard 3 [W] Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 50 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

Name: Samurott
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks from your opponent's Pokémon done to this Pokémon until the end of your opponent's next turn.
Effects: This attack also does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: Samurott leads its group strictly. Those who do not follow its rules receive a merciless thrashing.

Name: Raichu
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
Flavor-Text: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.

Name: Wattrel
Flavor-Text: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

Name: Clefairy
Effects: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.
Flavor-Text: On nights with a full moon, they gather together and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field.

Name: Ralts
Effects: Put a random Supporter card from your deck into your hand.
Flavor-Text: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

Name: Wynaut
Effects: During your opponent's next turn, attacks used by the Defending Pokémon cost 1 [C] more.
Flavor-Text: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.

Name: Oricorio
Effects: Discard a card from your hand. If you can't, this attack does nothing.
Flavor-Text: The elegant, attractive dance of these Oricorio is popular with adults, but the Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea.

Name: Anorith
Flavor-Text: Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wings through the water like oars on a boat. This Pokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.

Name: Poochyena
Effects: Draw a card for each Poochyena you have in play.
Flavor-Text: Poochyena pursue their prey in packs. Once the prey is exhausted, the pack finishes it off. But sometimes the prey retaliates, and the pack flees.

Name: Gulpin
Flavor-Text: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach comprises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.

Name: Vullaby
Effects: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.

Name: Genesect
Effects: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't attack.
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

Name: Dragonair
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may attach an Energy from your discard pile to your Active [N] Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It is called the divine Pokémon. When its entire body brightens slightly, the weather changes.

Name: Noivern
Effects: 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is chosen at random 3 times. For each time a Pokémon was chosen, do 60 damage to it.
Flavor-Text: In the dark, even Hydreigon are terrified of this Pokémon. But in the light, Noivern is the one that avoids battle.

Name: Cyclizar
Effects: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from—and effects of—attacks done to this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

Name: Raticate
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may look at the top 4 cards of your deck and put all Item cards you find there into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
Flavor-Text: Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.

Name: Aipom
Flavor-Text: Its tail moves with greater dexterity than its hands. Making deft use of this tail, Aipom lives high among the treetops.

Ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent gets 2 points.

Name: Alolan Vulpix
Flavor-Text: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

Name: Mudkip
Flavor-Text: When it uses its large tail fin, it picks up speed rapidly in the water. It is strong in spite of its small size.

Name: Marshtomp
Flavor-Text: It is at its best when on muddy ground that offers poor footing. It quickly overwhelms opponents that are bogged down and unable to move.

Name: Swampert
Effects: Discard a random Energy from among the Energy attached to all Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).
Flavor-Text: Swampert’s arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down Swampert’s foes. This Pokémon makes its nest on beautiful beaches.

Name: Electabuzz
Flavor-Text: Research is progressing on storing lightning in Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any time.

Name: Plusle
Effects: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out the electricity stored inside its body to create noises.

Name: Minun
Effects: If Plusle is on your Bench, this attack also does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: Its dislike of water makes it take shelter under the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms made of sparks for cheering.

Name: Mr. Mime
Effects: If this Pokémon and your opponent's Active Pokémon have the same amount of Energy attached, this attack does 40 more damage.
Flavor-Text: It’s known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

Name: Mewtwo
Effects: This attack does 40 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: The research efforts of a certain scientist ultimately resulted in this Pokémon. Its powers are dedicated to battling.

Name: Roggenrola
Flavor-Text: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.

Name: Boldore
Flavor-Text: It relies on sound in order to monitor what’s in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it’s facing.

Name: Falinks
Ability-Effect: If you have another Falinks in play, this Pokémon's attacks do +20 damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon, and this Pokémon takes −20 damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: The leader, known as the brass, uses its extendible horn to issue orders to the others when it’s time to change formation.

Name: Koffing
Effects: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.
Flavor-Text: Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped body, so it can cause massive explosions.

Name: Weezing
Flavor-Text: When it inhales poisonous gases from garbage, its body expands, and its insides smell much worse.

Name: Galarian Meowth
Flavor-Text: These daring Pokémon have coins on their foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder coins garner more respect among Meowth.

Name: Galarian Perrserker
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may put 2 random Pokémon Tool cards from your discard pile into your hand.
Flavor-Text: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

Name: Rattata
Effects: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon is common but hazardous. Its sharp incisors can easily cut right through hard wood.

Name: Raticate
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokémon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may look at the top 4 cards of your deck and put all Item cards you find there into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

Name: Smeargle
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may look at a random Supporter card from your opponent's hand. Use the effect of that card as the effect of this Ability.
Flavor-Text: The color of the mysterious fluid secreted from the tip of the tail is predetermined for each Smeargle.

Name: Buneary
Effects: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.
Flavor-Text: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.
